purpose: The captions of the shots and the users' corrections of their groups kept on the AI server, common to every QNC that uses it (docs/102 step 7b, user 2026-11-11: "common to all, we are building a base to train on"). The store program runs beside the AI server, which starts it like any plug-in (over TLS, with the token). Without a server a QNC keeps them in the databases of its computer.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

captioned.ok: [shot_key]: the shots of the project with a caption of the model

read_captions.ok: [{ from, to, text }]: the captions of the clip, by its frames

save_caption.ok: null: the caption kept, replacing the shot's earlier one

read_examples.ok: [{ key, label, vector }]: the corrections of the model, the oldest first

save_example.ok: null: the correction kept, replacing the shot's earlier one

rules: A shot is its project's public URI, clip and frames (project|clip|from|to). A caption or a correction outside the rules of the databases (qnc-shot-captions, qnc-shot-examples) is an error. The store program writes only the databases of its own computer.
acceptance: crates/qnc-shot-examples/examples/through_server.rs (a caption and a correction kept and read back through the AI server of the root it is given).
